name: Range

networks.note: Official testnet homepage only. Detail routes and public API schemas unconfirmed; browser policy verification unavailable. No portfolio or full-history integration.

risks: Third-party service availability and accuracy; opening an explorer does not prove inclusion.

eligibility.jurisdiction: Public information access; third-party terms apply.
eligibility.note: No wallet/account required by ZIGoals for these links.

notes: ZIGoals links to Range's test-network home page only. Its detail pages are not confirmed, and ZIGoals reads no portfolio or history from it.

name: ZIGScan

networks.note: Public source confirms tx/account/contract route shapes; homepage emits block links. Asset route unconfirmed. Link navigation is not receipt verification.

risks: Third-party service availability and accuracy; opening an explorer does not prove inclusion.

eligibility.jurisdiction: Public information access; third-party terms apply.
eligibility.note: No wallet/account required by ZIGoals for these links.

notes: ZIGoals links to ZIGScan's transaction, account and block pages. Opening a link shows ZIGScan's view; it is not a proof that a transaction succeeded.

name: ZIGChain Hub

networks.note: Canonical overview/validators/governance/staking/bridge information links only. Hub may retain its own network and offers financial actions; no automatic wallet connection or routing. Direct HTTP access returned403; routes verified in official docs.

risks: Verify the network in Hub; ZIGoals does not perform staking, voting or bridging.

eligibility.jurisdiction: Public information access; third-party terms apply.
eligibility.note: No wallet/account required by ZIGoals for these links.

notes: ZIGoals links to ZIGChain Hub's overview, validators, governance, staking and bridge pages. The Hub has its own network setting and offers money actions of its own; ZIGoals never connects your wallet to it or sends you through it.
